title: Kerala South: Madurai → Vagamon → Varkala → Alleppey → Wayanad

Madurai.desc: Madurai is a major tier II city in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is the cultural capital of Tamil Nadu and the administrative headquarters of Madurai district, which is governed by the Madurai Municipal Corporation established on 1 November 1866

Vagamon.desc: Vagamon is an Indian hill station and a revenue village located in Peerumedu Taluk of Idukki district, and also Meenachil taluk and Kanjirappally taluk of Kottayam district in the state of Kerala, India. Located in the Western Ghats 25 kilometres (16

Varkala.desc: Varkala, historically known as Balita is a coastal municipality and a northern suburb of Thiruvananthapuram, the capital city of the Indian state of Kerala.

Alleppey.desc: One day you’re in misty tea plantations in Munnar, the next you’re floating through the Alleppey backwaters, and then, somehow, you end the trip watching sunsets from the cliffs in Varkala. Houseboat in Kerala 🚤 Crociera tra le Backwaters di Alleppey

Wayanad.desc: A lush highland district in northern Kerala with waterfalls, caves, wildlife sanctuaries and spice estates, reached from Bengaluru via Bandipur/Tholpetty. Popular stops include Chembra Peak, Soochipara Falls and the Edakkal Caves. (sourced from r/india_tourism Wayanad threads)
